initial:
Use case: identity-preserve, production sprite animation atlas.
Reference image: existing original MOA explorer; preserve this exact character, outfit, bold dark navy outlines, vivid flat cel shading and high-angle orthographic game camera. Replace the inadequate walking animation with a carefully drawn eight-direction walk atlas.
Create ONE transparent PNG sprite sheet with EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and EIGHT ROWS, 32 separate full-body sprites, regular equal-size cells, generous transparent gutters. Tall canvas approximately 1536x3072. No labels, no grid, no ground, no shadows, no extra props.
Character: friendly chibi school-age explorer, tousled brown hair, teal hoodie, cream shorts, coral-red sneakers, yellow backpack. Same proportions and head scale in ALL frames; visible top of head, camera elevation around 55 degrees, all feet on the same baseline within each cell, stationary in place (no drift).
ROWS are SCREEN-space facing directions: row1 south/down directly toward viewer; row2 southwest/down-left three-quarter front; row3 west/left profile; row4 northwest/up-left three-quarter BACK; row5 north/up directly away, backpack centered, NO FACE; row6 northeast/up-right three-quarter BACK; row7 east/right profile; row8 southeast/down-right three-quarter front.
FOUR COLUMNS within EVERY row, left to right:
column1 IDLE: both shoes together, arms neutral.
column2 WALK CONTACT A: LEFT leg reaches FORWARD in that row's travel direction and RIGHT leg reaches BACK; RIGHT arm reaches FORWARD, LEFT arm BACK.
column3 WALK PASS: feet pass directly under pelvis, upright body, arms crossing neutral.
column4 WALK CONTACT B: RIGHT leg reaches FORWARD in that row's travel direction and LEFT leg reaches BACK; LEFT arm FORWARD, RIGHT arm BACK.
CRITICAL: column2 and column4 MUST be visibly OPPOSITE foot and arm poses, never duplicate the same leading leg. Clear balanced stride, consistent planted-foot baseline and body height. Do not mirror an entire sprite to fake walking, because that changes facing direction. Render each row's correct perspective including hidden far arm/leg. Clean alpha edges, no white sticker border. This is an original game asset, no existing franchise logos or characters.
correction:
Edit this original transparent 4-column by 8-row character sprite sheet. Keep canvas, every cell, character identity, every row's facing, and columns ONE TWO THREE completely unchanged. Change ONLY COLUMN FOUR (the rightmost sprite of every row).
The critical repair is the walk cycle: in column four, SWAP the front and back legs relative to column two. The shoe currently thrust forward must move BEHIND the pelvis, and the other shoe must thrust FORWARD. Swap the swinging arms too. Keep the torso and head facing the same direction! Do not flip/mirror the whole character. Deliberately exaggerate the opposite leg stride so contact-B is very clearly different from contact-A.
For front-facing and front-diagonal sprites: show the shoe on the viewer's LEFT in front and LOWER, and the shoe on the viewer's RIGHT behind and HIGHER, whereas column two has the opposite. Rear-facing rows need the opposite anatomical legs with the same camera perspective. Side-facing rows need the far leg ahead and near leg behind, switching arm overlap.
Maintain identical body proportions, fixed foot-ground baseline, bold navy outlines and cel shading. Transparent background preserved, no shadows, no text, no labels. Eight rightmost-cell poses changed, other 24 sprites unchanged.
